aesthetic: The Bid-Request Console — a real-time auction terminal at the protocol layer
anchor: The corpus is about the machine-readable handshakes that move advertising: the OpenRTB bid-request JSON, the AdCP negotiation grammar, the ARTF container colocated in the auction host's data center. So the world is a real-time-bidding console seen at the protocol layer — monospace spec text scrolling on a near-black terminal, a latency ticker counting milliseconds, two rival signal-colors for the two camps (AdCP and ARTF) negotiating across the substrate. Read off the OpenRTB/AdCP JSON object and the RTB trading terminal, not a humanities page.
rationale: The structural metaphor is the layer stack and the agent-to-agent handshake (substrate MCP -> negotiation AdCP / transport ARTF -> payment AP2/ACP), so figures should read like a protocol diagram and a market console: container tiles, request/response arrows, a latency bar, monospace numerals. The brand accent is a PHOSPHOR / SIGNAL GREEN — the live-terminal, machine-is-trading color — deliberately distinct from every other Media & Advertising corpus on the shelf (the CTV-identity cobalt, the Fox-Roku violet) and from the institutional blues elsewhere. The figure palette pairs the green substrate with a TEAL for the AdCP negotiation camp, an AMBER for the IAB/ARTF transport camp (the latency/incumbent signal), a ROSE for the payment/commerce layer, and a SLATE-INDIGO for the walled-garden enclosure. Cool near-white paper for day; a true terminal near-black, lit-spec-on-dark register for night. Sharp modern UI radii, a grotesque display (the console chyron), a readable serif for long-form, and a true monospace for the protocol's many objects and numbers.

fonts.display: 'Arial Nova', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.body: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Times New Roman', serif
